data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Kalap refers to the god of time and creation, responsible for the cyclical nature of the universe. The name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'kal' meaning 'time'. The name Kalap carries the meaning “Time, Epoch” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kalap usually hope their child will grow to embody time, epoch and live with faith, good character and purpose.
